approvers: Contracts director, procurement, directors for any new supplier
reason: We do this with film and tape by our own labour at about 12 a m2. This is 19 a m2 and it comes from a contractor who would be on my site and see my programme. I won't put a competitor on site for a more expensive product.
objection: ACHV is a contractor too. I don't want a competitor on my site or seeing my programme, and it costs over 50% more than what we do now.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, sheet or board with tape applied by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: Product-only supply at around 5 a m2 that my own labour can apply, with a reference from another large Maltese contractor showing it is cheaper than film and tape all-in.
